items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Yes, and we had Adelle playing the harp... And immediately, Joe says, come to work for me.

ctx.x: 52nd Street. He was working there with -- and he had Buddy Rich on drums. I don't remember the other people. Oh, and we had Marty Mars[ala] on trumpet.

Yes, and we had Adelle playing the harp. And people were paying to come and to listen. Now, you can imagine the shock that is to a musician who's always played on a stage for a stripper or an M.C. or a snake dancer, or some sort of act, which the band was to be heard but not seen, essentially.
